::: {#exm-bca-acceleration}
#### Acceleration from three deleted estimates

If the differences $\hparam_{(\cdot)} - \hparam_{(i)}$ are $1$, $1$, and $-2$,
the sum of their cubes is $1 + 1 - 8 = -6$
and the sum of their squares is $6$, so

$$\hat a = \frac{-6}{6 \cdot 6^{3/2}} \approx -0.068.$$

:::
